name: Automotive Underbody Cross Member Benchmark (Benchmark 2)
description: A simulation benchmark for evaluating automotive underbody cross member performance and simulation tool accuracy on that component.
evaluation_method: RMSE / L2 error (numerical error norms comparing simulated vs. reference displacement/stress fields)
general_score_metric: RMSE (root mean squared error) on predicted displacements/stresses (sometimes reported as normalized error or relative percentage error)
reputation: A niche benchmark in computational structural mechanics used for validating simulation tools and numerical solvers; moderate recognition within engineering simulation communities.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark oriented to numerical simulation; small/specialized test case where results depend strongly on mesh, solver and boundary-condition choices; low contamination risk for language models.
